sources.slope_deg: Computed by TwinWorlds from NASA PDS LRO LOLA LDEM 16 ppd, block-averaged to 5.69 km pixels (Earth uses 5.55 km), mean over a 55 km box
sources.relief_55km_m: Computed by TwinWorlds from LRO LOLA LDEM: std dev of 5.69 km elevation within a 55 km box
sources.albedo: LRO LOLA LDAM 4 ppd normal albedo at 1064 nm (Lemelin et al. 2016), mean per 1 deg cell. Single wavelength, not broadband like Earth (MODIS) and Mars (TES): approximate comparison
sources.lst_day_c: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Product (Williams et al. 2017, Icarus 283), bolometric temperature, nadir data 2009-2015, mean of 0.25 h local-time bins between 9.75 and 11.25 h (centred on 10:30, the Terra overpass time used for Earth) per 1 deg cell (2 of 4 0.5 deg pixels sampled); empty cells filled from neighbours
sources.lst_night_c: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Product (Williams et al. 2017, Icarus 283), bolometric temperature, nadir data 2009-2015, mean of 0.25 h local-time bins between 21.75 and 23.25 h (centred on 22:30) per 1 deg cell (2 of 4 0.5 deg pixels sampled); empty cells filled from neighbours
sources.lst_swing_c: Computed: lst_day_c minus lst_night_c (LRO Diviner GCP)

notes: Diviner gaps filled from neighbours: day 0, night 0; still empty: day 0, night 0
